name: zsnd_play_handle_update3d_dispatch
description: zSndPlayHandle::Update3DDispatch routes 3D position updates to the active DirectSound or A3D backend and rejects unsupported backends.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage relies on the backend-specific 3D update smokes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4a2a30 dispatches backend 0 to zSndPlayHandle::Update3D, backend 1 to zSndPlayHandle::Update3D_A3D, and falls through with zero for unsupported backend ids.
The native smokes verify A3D 3D state updates, DirectSound pan/volume/frequency updates, and unsupported-backend dispatch behavior.
